surface_depth_method: Each pair marks the same fixed corner on the two original photographs. Signed Y increases into the building. The frontal plane is supported by the stone and brick frontage, with the upper window bay inset. The normal direction in 2015 is separately supported by 15 edges of the visible return. Values in metres inherit the public historical street camera scale.

openings.inspection: The two near-edge open leaves belong to the eastern half; the western pair is closed. The unobstructed December 2015 street frame shows four closed leaves. In both Commons images the open half shows two guard rails. The other pair has three main glazed cells per leaf. Two dark gaps interrupt the top and bottom right pane in the August 2017 view.

uncertainty: Aperture edges generally ±4 original pixels. The western jamb and behind-rail depth are less well constrained. Glazing crosspoints are approximate to 5–12 oblique pixels. The absolute metre scale has approximately 7% uncertainty.
